name: Koi no Su ☆ Ichacolize
original_name: こいのす☆イチャコライズ
source:
Koi no Su ☆ Ichacolize is all about building a ‘love nest’ where you can be lovey-dovey with your ideal girlfriend. 

After choosing your heroine and deciding on your name at the beginning, the game branches off into three separate routes which all take place in the same setting, but the protagonist's personalities and backgrounds are different. 

Ichika is a servile waitress who catches your eye at a café that you frequent. Sachi is a petite girl who you used to play with and with whom you were entrusted on days when she attends a cram school nearby. Natsume is the imouto of your next door neighbour who temporarily lives there when her older sister studies abroad.

[Edited from [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/03/01/march-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
《Koi no Su ☆ Ichacolize》講述建造「愛巢」的故事，讓你和理想女友在其中甜蜜相處。

遊戲開始時選擇女主角並決定名字後，遊戲會分成三條路線。三條路線發生在同一背景中，但主角的性格與經歷各不相同。

一花是在你常去的咖啡館工作的順從女服務生，她吸引了你的目光。幸是你兒時一起玩耍的嬌小女孩，在她去附近補習班的日子裡，受託由你照顧。夏目是住在隔壁鄰居家的妹妹，姊姊出國留學期間暫時住在那裡。

[改編自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/03/01/march-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
